cim: FedEx Preps 'Smart' Peak Season With AI and New Tracking Tools
kihagyva: P3: 44 pont, tendencia 20%, jóváhagyás után fordul
cim_eredeti: FedEx Preps 'Smart' Peak Season With AI and New Tracking Tools
szoveg_eredeti:
FedEx (CCJ Top 250, No. 1) is preparing for what it calls its smartest peak holiday season yet, combining its global industrial network with digital intelligence, artificial intelligence and predictive analytics for greater transparency and control over their shipments.

The shipping giant announced a suite of upgrades for the holiday rush, highlighting enhanced tracking tools, security features for high-value items, and automated post-purchase options designed to reduce holiday stress for both businesses and consumers.

"Peak means as much to our customers as it does to us, and we've been preparing all year for another successful season together," Brie Carere, executive vice president and chief customer officer at FedEx, said in a statement.

Carere noted that the company is aiming to put the power of its physical network and digital intelligence directly into the hands of customers, providing more control, greater transparency and total peace of mind.

Among the new and expanded features rolling out this season are:

FedEx is leaning heavily on emerging technologies to manage the surge in package volume. The company is deploying AI-powered robots from Dexterity and Berkshire Grey to autonomously load and unload trailers. On the highways, FedEx has continued its partnership with Aurora on autonomous linehaul trucking development.

To mitigate logistical hurdles, the company utilizes predictive technology to anticipate equipment issues and route packages around potential supply chain bottlenecks. Additionally, a team of 24/7 meteorologists uses sophisticated modeling to proactively divert flights and trucks ahead of severe weather disruptions.
